$schema: Signblast shared UI text. Both the website and the app use these exact strings. Add keys here before using new text on either side. {x} marks a value filled in at runtime.

home.title: Spell with your hands.
home.body: A word appears. Sign each letter to the camera. The faster you spell, the higher you score.
home.streakNone: Play today to start a streak

sprint.title: Sprint
sprint.body: 60 seconds. Spell as many words as you can.

daily.title: Today's five
daily.body: The same five words for everyone, once a day.

practice.title: Practice
practice.body: Pick your letters. No timer, hints on.

camera.title: Turn on your camera
camera.body: Signblast reads your hand shape on this device. Video never leaves it.
camera.denied: Camera is blocked. Allow it in your settings, or practise with the keyboard.
camera.unavailable: The camera couldn't start. Check it isn't in use by another app, or use the keyboard.
camera.noHand: Show one hand to the camera

practice.title: Choose letters
practice.body: Words will only use the letters you pick. Grey letters are still being tuned.

results.dailyBody: Come back tomorrow for five new words.

learn.title: 26 handshapes
learn.body: Tap a letter to see how it's made, then check your sign with the camera.
learn.checking: Show the sign to the camera
learn.beta: Still learning to read this one
learn.teachBody: Hold the sign steady while Signblast records {n} samples. It learns your hand and reads this letter more reliably.

progress.title: Your week
progress.empty: Play a game to see your week.

settings.title: Settings
settings.resetConfirm: This clears your streak and mastery on this device.
settings.privacy: Hand tracking runs on your device. Nothing is uploaded.

sprint.title: Sign Sprint
sprint.body: One letter at a time. 60 seconds. Build a combo.
rules: Every 3 in a row raises your multiplier, up to ×5
8 seconds per letter, then it counts as a miss

spell.title: Spell It
spell.body: Fingerspell whole words before 90 seconds run out.
rules: Sign each letter of the word in order
Hints halve the points for that letter
Finish a word for a 200 point bonus

echo.title: Echo
echo.body: Watch a sequence, then sign it back from memory.
rules: Sign them back in the same order
One mistake ends it. One peek per game

mystery.title: Mystery Word
mystery.body: Guess the hidden word one signed letter at a time.
rules: Sign a letter to guess it

duel.title: Duel
duel.body: Two players, one camera. First to sign it wins the point.
rules: Player 1 on the left, Player 2 on the right
Both race to sign the same letter
First to 10 points, or the most after 60 seconds

daily.title: Today's five
daily.body: The same five words for everyone, once a day.

practice.title: Practice
practice.body: Pick your letters. No timer, hints on.

game.duelNeedCamera: Duel needs the camera. Two hands, one on each side.
game.duelKeys: Keyboard: Player 1 types the letter, Player 2 holds Shift
